t: This is Topolski Studio, a London arts educational organisation. It takes its name from Feliks Topolski, the Polish expressionist painter and draughtsman who worked mainly in the United Kingdom. Topolski lived from 1907 to 1989, and his name here ties the place to his legacy as an artist. I can't tell you more about the studio's programmes from what I have, but the name itself is the clue: this is a place that carries a working painter's name into the teaching of art.
